name: Restore terminals as visible tree nodes
description: Refactor terminal placement so every Hickory-owned terminal inside the open folder is a visible child node at its cwd, with collapsed-subtree aggregation and keyboard activation. Remove the hover-only icon design. Acceptance: root and nested placement, live cwd movement, collapsed counts, activation, close action, and outside-root exclusion have regression tests tied to the terminal guarantee.
result: Replaced hover-only directory decorations with visible terminal child nodes at root and nested cwd locations. Preserved urgency ordering, honest live-cwd tooltips, collapsed subtree counts, activation, close menu, and outside-root exclusion; added stable workspace node attributes and guarantee-linked tests. Verification: 158 web test files and 1,778 tests passed, npm production build passed, TypeScript typecheck passed, source-length ratchet passed, git diff --check passed. Visual density with many terminals remains an explicitly recorded manual-testing caveat.

name: Make the workspace tree editor-grade
description: Add roving keyboard focus, structural expand/collapse navigation, range/column selection over compatible editable fields, semantic rename/edit commands for files, windows, tickets, issues, and reviews, plus preview and per-node outcomes for cross-backend batches. Acceptance: keyboard catalogue integration, accessibility behavior, capability filtering, immutable identifier refusals, and partial-failure reporting are tested.
result: Implemented editor-grade workspace-tree interaction: one roving tab stop; visible-row and structural parent/child arrow navigation; Enter activation; Shift range marks; configurable Alt+Shift column extension; multi-line CodeMirror semantic rename with rectangular/multi-cursor editing, validation, per-node outcomes, and retry that never resends successes. Filesystem rename is bound now; the generic item/callback seam is ready for window and provider nodes. Added strict guarantee and updated design/status. Verification: 1,793 web tests pass, typecheck and production build pass, file-length ratchet and diff check pass. Full Rust suite reached an unrelated existing hick-literate document_links failure (4 tests expect notes.md but pipeline returned no such key); no changed tree/editor code is involved.

name: Add Apply and Dry Run toolbar to the Files buffer
description: When the literal Files CodeMirror buffer differs from its projection, show a toolbar across the top of the buffer. Apply executes the same semantic reconciliation currently bound to Mod-s. Dry Run must perform no writes and show the exact ordered plan: filesystem renames/moves with from/to, creates with kind/path, provider title edits with target/value, and deletions awaiting no-trash confirmation. Invalid or ambiguous edits must show their refusal in Dry Run. The toolbar is hidden when clean and busy-safe. Preserve Mod-s as an Apply shortcut. Update the strict guarantee and cover clean/dirty visibility, exact plan, no mutation on dry run, apply, and deletion review. Verify against the live app if practical.
result: Added a dirty-only Files buffer toolbar with Dry Run and Apply. Both actions use the same validated, ordered reconciliation plan; Dry Run shows exact full-path/value changes without writes, while Apply executes them. Preserved explicit deletion confirmation and Cmd/Ctrl-S Apply. Updated guarantees/specs and verified focused typecheck/tests (54), full web suite (1,809), production build, file-length ratchet, diff check, and live just-dev Playwright flow.

name: Add local Hickory window discovery and focus
description: Create a machine-local registry for independently running Hickory Docs processes, including folder, per-window title, liveness, and a focus operation exposed through the desktop shell seam. Show other windows at their folders and focus them on activation. Acceptance: stale entries disappear, browser-only hick up degrades honestly, titles are per workspace/window rather than one global override, and the registry contains no remote service.

name: Implement GitLab merge requests in the workspace tree
description: Add the GitLab provider adapter at the existing workspace-node seam, including branch matching, lazy reviews/checks/logs/comments, unread projection, edits, and honestly labeled current-head conflict analysis.

name: Implement GitHub issues in associated folders
description: Persist credentialless folder associations, lazily expand issue details/comments, edit title/body, append comments, and project unread notifications to the nearest visible ancestor.
result: Built root-relative GitHub issue associations in .hick-workspace.json with no credentials, lazy details/comments, title/body edits, new comments, and tree-aware unread projection. Verified by backend association/notification tests and Files-pane interaction tests.

name: Implement GitHub pull requests in the workspace tree
description: Discover PRs for the checked-out branch, lazily expand reviews/checks/logs/comments, edit titles and bodies, add comments, project unread notifications, and compare fetched current heads without touching the working tree.
result: Built the local gh-backed GitHub PR adapter and Files-pane nodes. Details are lazy; checks expose bounded logs; current fetched heads are compared with git merge-tree and name provider plus commit authors; unread stays explicit until marked read. Verified by Rust unit tests, frontend component tests, the full 1,799-test web suite, typecheck, and production build.

name: Replace the Files button tree with a literal tree text buffer
description: The Files pane must be a CodeMirror text buffer, not a focusable ARIA tree of buttons. Its document is an indented significant-whitespace projection of workspace nodes. Clicking places an ordinary caret; arrow/selection/multi-cursor/column editing are native editor behavior. Editing names performs semantic filesystem/provider renames; indentation changes move filesystem entries; adding/removing lines maps to create/delete with safe review for destructive changes. Folding replaces button expansion. Preserve terminals, work items, reviews, unread projection, and provider expansion as typed lines/widgets. Done only after a live just-dev Playwright flow edits tree text directly without Ctrl+Shift+E or F2.
result: Replaced the filesystem button tree with a literal CodeMirror buffer. Two-space indentation and trailing slashes encode hierarchy; save maps name/indent edits to parent-first rename/move, inserted lines to create/mkdir, and removed subtrees to explicit no-trash delete review. Preserved folding, ribbon metadata, direct file activation, indented terminal/GitHub issue projections, and semantic GitHub issue title editing. Rewrote stale guarantees/spec language. Verified 1,807 web tests, production build, typecheck, file-length ratchet, Rust tree-file-op HTTP tests, and live just-dev Playwright rename/create/confirmed-delete without F2 or Ctrl+Shift+E.

name: Add folder work-item providers and unread projection
description: Introduce provider-neutral work-item nodes and adapters, initially Jira tickets and GitHub issues. Persist folder associations without credentials; keep credentials machine-local. Support lazy expansion, status/body/comments, title/body edits, new comments, and unread badges rendered on the nearest visible ancestor. Acceptance: provider fixtures and tree tests cover placement, expansion, mutation capability/refusal, refresh, and badge movement.

name: Make the Files pane a workspace-tree lens
description: Replace the filesystem-only tree plus hidden terminal icons with one extensible, keyboard-operable workspace tree. It must place terminals by cwd; discover and focus other Hickory Docs windows; associate Jira tickets and GitHub issues with folders; show GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests under matching clones/worktrees; expose ticket, review, check, comment, log, mergeability, and current-head conflict details lazily; project unread badges onto the nearest visible ancestor; and route edits through provider-specific capabilities without pretending cross-provider batches are atomic. Credentials remain machine-local and Hickory operates no relay. Acceptance: the design of record defines stable node identity, placement, capabilities, persistence, refresh, unread projection, local-window IPC, provider boundaries, and honest predictive-conflict language; implementation is split into independently verified slices.

name: Define the workspace-tree contract
description: Write the design of record and strict guarantees for heterogeneous nodes, stable identity, folder placement, expansion, editing capabilities, unread projection, provider extensibility, local-only credentials, and non-atomic batch results. Reconcile the stale terminal-row guarantee with the chosen node design. Acceptance: specs state current versus desired behavior precisely and name implementation seams without inventing a second document format.
result: Wrote the design of record in docs/specs/freeform/the-workspace-tree.md, summarized it in AGENTS.md, reconciled the terminal contract, and added strict partially/not-yet-verified guarantees for the lens, local window focus, unread projection, and review placement. Reviewed against notes-ide.md, local-only.md, architecture.md, lenses.md, and current shell/tree code. git diff --check passed.

name: Make Files edits order-insensitive and enable multi-cursor editing
description: Treat reordering unchanged Files-buffer rows as a presentation-only edit that produces no dirty state, Dry Run operation, or Apply write. Configure the Files CodeMirror surface with the same multi-selection and rectangular/column-selection interaction available in normal markdown editors. Preserve significant indentation semantics and real rename/move/create/delete behavior. Add focused regression tests, live interaction coverage where practical, and update the workspace-tree guarantee/spec.
result: Made Files-buffer row order presentation-only by matching unchanged root-relative path/kind identities before interpreting remaining edits, with name-similarity matching preserving identity through column-style prefix edits. Clean reorders show no toolbar or plan and reordered rows retain correct activation/context identity. Kept the same shared CodeMirror multi-cursor/rectangular-selection extension as document editors, added Tab indentation parity, and verified Ctrl/Cmd-S applies the shared plan. Updated the workspace-tree spec/guarantee and AGENTS record. Verified 16 focused tests, all 1,813 web tests, typecheck, production build, file-length ratchet, diff check, and a live just-dev Playwright filesystem round trip using Ctrl+S.

name: Implement Jira tickets in associated folders
description: Add the Jira provider adapter at the existing work-item seam, including credentialless folder associations, lazy status/body/comments, edits/new comments, and explicit tree-aware unread handling.

name: Add code-review providers, checks, and conflict analysis
description: Add GitHub pull request and GitLab merge request adapters, attached to clones/worktrees by normalized remote and checked-out head branch. Expand review status, comments, draft/open state, mergeability, checks, and lazy logs. Compute and label conflicts among current fetched heads honestly, including authors/developers. Acceptance: provider fixtures, git graph tests, lazy log tests, and explicit unavailable/stale states.

name: Make the live Files pane genuinely editor-like
description: The current implementation passes component tests but does not feel editor-like under just dev: keyboard ownership is obscure, rename is Shift+R-only, and the rename editor appears outside the rows. Reproduce the actual mounted pane, make focus/cursor state obvious and reachable, provide conventional F2/direct rename, edit names in their rows with CodeMirror-grade multi-row behavior, and add an end-to-end browser flow so this cannot regress behind narrow tests.
result: Fixed the live Files-pane gap: Show Files now moves DOM focus into the tree; keyboard point has a persistent editor-like highlight; F2 opens a CodeMirror name editor over the selected row with Enter apply/Escape cancel; marked rows retain the multi-line rename column. Added Playwright and just test-e2e, then ran it against the actual just dev Vite+engine pair: it focused Files, arrowed, created a fixture at point, renamed it through the real API, and cleaned it up. Full web suite passes 1,800 tests, typecheck/build pass, and the source-length/diff gates pass.
